accessLogs.description: Authentication attempt, one per object, made against the cluster.

MongoDBAccessLogs.description: Authentication attempt, one per object, made against the cluster.

authResult.description: Flag that indicates whether the response should return successful authentication attempts only.

authSource.description: Database against which someone attempted to authenticate.

failureReason.description: Reason that the authentication failed. Null if authentication succeeded.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal character string that identifies the project.

hostname.description: Human-readable label that identifies the hostname of the target node that received the authentication attempt.

ipAddress.description: Internet Protocol address that attempted to authenticate with the database.

logLine.description: Text of the host log concerning the authentication attempt.

timestamp.description: Date and time when someone made this authentication attempt. MongoDB Cloud represents this timestamp in ISO 8601 format in UTC.

username.description: Username used to authenticate against the database.
